Midnight Madness at TIFF 2026 opens with director Joshua Giuliano’s River

by W. Andrew Powell August 17, 2026
written by W. Andrew Powell August 17, 2026
34
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:42
Instaread

Classic horror, blood-soaked action, and absurd comedies collide at this year’s Midnight Madness at the 51st Toronto International Film Festival, an this year including two special screenings.

TIFF returns from September 10 to 20, 2026, and as always, Midnight Madness is a fan favourite. Opening night film River, from director Joshua Giuliano, kicks off the programme, while director Duncan Jones’ Rogue Trooper closes it out.

The rest of the programme features:

  • Anchors Aweigh; director Matt Barats
  • Arrested Memory; director SABU
  • Half; director Samjad
  • Kick On; director Nick Kozakis
  • Ladies and Gentlemen, Brian Mulroney; director Matthew Rankin
  • The Face of Horror; director Anna Biller
  • The Spiral; director Paolo Strippoli
  • Vintage Violence; director Eugene Kotlyarenko

For the diehard horror fans, TIFF is also planning special screenings of Na Hong-jin’s Hope on TIFF-eve, September 9, and Curry Barker’s hit, Obsession, on September 11.

TIFF’s 2026 Midnight Madness lineup returns to the Royal Alexandra Theatre and includes six world premieres that features “masked killers, medieval ghosts, drug-addled mobsters, denim-desiring yakuza, amnesiac detectives, martial artist vampires, interstellar infantrymen, competing Canadian politicians, Faustian bargains, existential ennui, and even an infamous talking pineapple.”

TIFF: The Market is also hosting a special moderated Dialogues conversation with director Barker and breakout star Inde Navarrette (most recently announced to star as Rogue in the MCU’s upcoming X-Men films) at the John Bassett Theatre. To attend, you’ll need to be a TIFF pass holder, or have a public ticket.

Visit tiff.net for the full schedule. TIFF tickets go on sale to members between August 21 and August 27, based on Membership level; and tickets go on sale for the public on August 31.
